title_zh: People and places — 第10节可背诵讲义
body_en: When you visit a new place, watch how people greet each other. Some shake hands; some smile and say hello. Learn one local custom and follow it carefully. Write a short diary: who you met, where you went, what surprised you. Places become real when you remember the people.
body_zh: 到新地方时，观察人们如何打招呼。有人握手，有人微笑问好。学一项当地习俗并认真遵守。写短日记：见了谁、去了哪、什么让你惊讶。当你记住那里的人，地方才变得真实。
